declarations.name: norm_masked_residue_sq_le_log_energy
declarations.doc: A masked radial residue is at most the source log energy times the mask's radial square density.

declarations.name: norm_residue_sq_le_log_energy
declarations.doc: A radial Dirichlet residue is controlled by the exact logarithmic energy constant, even when no first-mean Tauberian conclusion is available.

declarations.name: coprime_mask_square_residue
declarations.doc: The actual radial square density of the coprimality mask.

declarations.name: exists_forward_coprime_energy
declarations.doc: The same actual source energy constant controls every finite coprime radial residue. Full positivity is the only arithmetic premise.

declarations.name: exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance
declarations.doc: Every full-positive source has a finite, nonnegative residual variance, with energy coefficient exactly the residue square plus that variance.
